ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Alfred Herbert (India) Limited's 106th Annual General Meeting confirmed the adoption of its FY2025-26 financial statements, which received an unqualified audit opinion with no material adverse remarks or observations. A significant key takeaway for shareholders is the proposed declaration of a 200% (Rs. 20 per share) dividend for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The proceedings summary indicates no red flags or material negative impacts, highlighting a healthy financial overview and commitment to shareholder returns.
